tip: 結果像掛在某件事上面,那件事一動,結果就跟著變
example: The delivery date depends on when we receive your payment.
exampleZh: 交貨日期取決於我們何時收到您的款項。

quiz.q: Small suppliers often depend ___ a few major clients for most of their revenue.
quiz.explanation: depend on=依賴/取決於,小型供應商大部分營收靠少數幾家大客戶。in 是 believe in(相信)的搭配;to 是 belong to(屬於);for 是 apply for(申請),接在 depend 後都不成立。

tip: for 指向你想拿到的那樣東西,申請就是朝它伸手
example: Over three hundred people applied for the marketing manager position.
exampleZh: 超過三百人應徵這個行銷經理職位。

quiz.q: If you want the scholarship, you must apply ___ it before the end of May.
quiz.explanation: apply for=申請某樣東西,獎學金就是想爭取的目標。apply to 後面接的是機構(apply to a university)或表示「適用於」;on 用在 depend on(取決於);with 用在 comply with(遵守),都不能接在 apply 後面。

tip: with 是和規定站在同一邊,不唱反調
example: All suppliers must comply with the new safety regulations by June.
exampleZh: 所有供應商必須在六月前遵守新的安全規定。

quiz.q: The factory was fined because it failed to comply ___ local environmental rules.
quiz.explanation: comply with=遵守,工廠沒有遵守當地環保規定才被罰款。to 是 conform to(符合)的搭配;in 是 result in(導致);for 是 account for(說明),都不能接在 comply 後面。

tip: 活動像一個圈子,人走進圈子裡才算參加
example: All new employees participate in a two-day orientation program at headquarters.
exampleZh: 所有新進員工都會在總部參加為期兩天的職前訓練。

quiz.q: Only twelve of the invited managers participated ___ last week's leadership workshop.
quiz.explanation: participate in=參與某項活動,受邀的經理中只有十二位參加了工作坊。on 是 focus on(專注)的搭配;at 是 arrive at(抵達);for 是 register for(報名),接在 participate 後都不通。

tip: to 是一支箭頭,把力氣或錢送往某個目標
example: Her research contributed to the company's fastest product launch ever.
exampleZh: 她的研究促成了公司史上最快的產品上市。

quiz.q: Heavy rain and poor signage both contributed ___ the delay at the port.
quiz.explanation: contribute to=促成/造成某結果,大雨和標示不清共同造成港口延誤。for 是 account for(說明)的搭配;in 是 result in(導致);with 是 deal with(處理),都不能接在 contribute 後面。

tip: 回應是把話送回給對方,方向詞自然用 to
example: Please respond to the client's email before you leave the office today.
exampleZh: 請在今天離開辦公室前回覆客戶的電子郵件。

quiz.q: The help desk usually responds ___ customer complaints within one business day.
quiz.explanation: respond to=回應某人或某事,客服在一個工作天內回覆客訴。at 是 look at(看)的搭配;on 是 insist on(堅持);of 是 consist of(由…組成),都無法接在 respond 後面。

tip: with 是面對面跟問題交手,而不是繞道躲開
example: Our team deals with over two hundred service requests each week.
exampleZh: 我們團隊每週處理超過兩百件服務需求。

quiz.q: Ms. Lin was hired to deal ___ complaints from overseas distributors.
quiz.explanation: deal with=處理,林小姐是被聘來處理海外經銷商的抱怨。deal in 指「經營某類商品」(deal in antiques),語意不合;for 用在 apply for(申請);to 用在 respond to(回應),都不能接在 deal 後面。

zh: 佔(比例);說明(原因或去向)
tip: 帳本上每一筆都要負責交代,佔多少、為什麼,都用 for
example: Online orders account for nearly half of our annual revenue.
exampleZh: 線上訂單佔我們年營收將近一半。

quiz.q: The sales director could not account ___ the missing receipts from March.
quiz.explanation: account for=說明原因或去向,業務總監無法交代三月缺少的收據。of 是 approve of(贊同)的搭配;on 是 depend on(取決於);with 是 comply with(遵守),都不能接在 account 後面。

tip: 所有權像箭頭指回主人,to 就指向那個擁有者
example: The laptop on the front desk belongs to our new intern.
exampleZh: 櫃檯上那台筆電是我們新來的實習生的。

quiz.q: These patents belong ___ the parent company, not to the local branch.
quiz.explanation: belong to=屬於某人或某單位,這些專利屬於母公司。belong with 另有「該和…擺在一起」的意思(These files belong with the others),講的是歸位而非所有權,句尾又有 not to the local branch 要對稱,所以只能填 to;for 是 apply for(申請);in 是 result in(導致),都不能接在 belong 後面。

tip: of 是把整體拆開看內容物,像在讀成分表
example: The training course consists of four online modules and one workshop.
exampleZh: 這門訓練課程由四個線上單元和一場工作坊組成。

quiz.q: The review panel consists ___ three managers and one outside consultant.
quiz.explanation: consist of=由…組成,審查小組由三位主管與一位外部顧問構成。consist in 意思是「在於(本質)」,語意不合;from 用在 result from(起因於);with 用在 comply with(遵守),要表達「由…構成」則可改說 be made up of。

tip: in 後面裝的是結局,事情往前走進那個結果裡
example: The software upgrade resulted in a sharp drop in support calls.
exampleZh: 這次軟體升級使客服來電量大幅下降。

quiz.q: Ignoring the maintenance schedule may result ___ costly equipment failures.
quiz.explanation: result in=導致某結果,忽略保養排程可能造成昂貴的設備故障。result from 是「起因於」,後面要接原因,方向剛好相反;on 用在 focus on(專注);to 用在 lead to(導致),都不能接在 result 後面。

tip: from 指來源,箭頭往回走去找原因
example: The shortage resulted from a strike at the shipping company.
exampleZh: 這次缺貨起因於貨運公司的罷工。

quiz.q: Most of the errors in the report resulted ___ outdated sales data.
quiz.explanation: result from=起因於,報告裡的錯誤來自過時的銷售資料。result in 是「導致」,後面接的是結果而非原因;to 用在 contribute to(促成);of 用在 consist of(由…組成),都不能接在 result 後面。

tip: 鏡頭對焦時焦點落在某一個點上,所以用 on
example: This quarter we will focus on customers in Southeast Asia.
exampleZh: 這一季我們會把重點放在東南亞的客戶。

quiz.q: Please focus ___ the budget section first; the rest can wait until Friday.
quiz.explanation: focus on=把注意力集中在某處,請先專心處理預算那一段。at 是 arrive at(抵達)的搭配;in 是 specialize in(專精);to 是 refer to(提及),都不能接在 focus 後面。

tip: 把手用力壓在某個要求上,壓著不肯移開
example: The client insisted on a written confirmation before the shipment left.
exampleZh: 客戶堅持出貨前要有書面確認。

quiz.q: Mr. Ito insists ___ reviewing every contract himself before signing.
quiz.explanation: insist on=堅持某事,後面接名詞或 V-ing,伊藤先生堅持親自看過每份合約才簽。in 是 participate in(參與)的搭配;for 是 qualify for(符合資格);of 是 approve of(贊同),都不能接在 insist 後面。

tip: 專長就是你長期待在裡面的那個領域
example: The firm specializes in tax planning for small business owners.
exampleZh: 這家事務所專門為小型企業主做稅務規劃。

quiz.q: Dr. Ramos specializes ___ workplace safety training for factory staff.
quiz.explanation: specialize in=專精於某個領域,拉莫斯博士專攻工廠員工的職場安全訓練。on 是 focus on(專注)的搭配;at 出現在 be good at(擅長)這類形容詞句型;with 是 deal with(處理),都不能接在 specialize 後面。

tip: 好處是從某個來源流過來的,來源用 from
example: Small local vendors benefit from the new online payment system.
exampleZh: 本地的小攤商從新的線上支付系統中獲益。

quiz.q: Employees who work night shifts will benefit ___ the revised overtime policy.
quiz.explanation: benefit from=從…受惠,上夜班的員工會因為修訂後的加班辦法受益。of 是 consist of(由…組成)的搭配;for 是 qualify for(符合資格);to 是 respond to(回應),都不能接在 benefit 後面。

tip: 手指往那份資料一指,to 就是指過去的方向
example: Please refer to page twelve for the full warranty terms.
exampleZh: 完整的保固條款請參閱第十二頁。

quiz.q: In her speech, the CEO referred ___ the merger only once.
quiz.explanation: refer to=提及或參閱,執行長在演說中只提過併購一次。at 是 look at(看)的搭配;on 是 depend on(取決於);for 是 account for(說明),都不能接在 refer 後面。

zh: 報名;選修;註冊(課程、活動)
tip: for 表示「為了參加那件事」才去登記
example: You can register for the workshop through the company intranet.
exampleZh: 你可以透過公司內部網站報名這場工作坊。

quiz.q: Staff members who wish to attend must register ___ the seminar by Friday.
quiz.explanation: register for=報名某項活動或課程,想參加的員工必須在週五前完成報名。register with 是「向某機構登記」(register with an agency),後面接的是單位不是活動;in 用在 participate in(參與);to 用在 refer to(參閱),都不能接在 register 後面。

zh: 符合…的資格;有資格獲得
tip: for 指向那份資格或福利,你夠格才拿得到
example: Part-time staff qualify for health insurance after six months of service.
exampleZh: 兼職員工在服務滿六個月後即可享有公司提供的健康保險。

quiz.q: Only orders over five thousand dollars qualify ___ free international shipping.
quiz.explanation: qualify for=符合資格取得某項待遇,滿五千元的訂單才享有免費國際運送。qualify as 是「具備某種身分」(qualify as an engineer),後面接身分而非福利;to 用在 respond to(回應);of 用在 approve of(贊同),都不能接在 qualify 後面。

tip: of 帶出你心裡認可的那件事;公文上「核准」則不加 of,直接 approve
example: The board did not approve of the proposed office relocation.
exampleZh: 董事會並不贊成這項辦公室搬遷提案。

quiz.q: Her parents never approved ___ her decision to start a business abroad.
quiz.explanation: approve of=贊同某人的想法或做法,她父母始終不贊成她到國外創業。on 是 insist on(堅持)的搭配;with 是 comply with(遵守);for 是 apply for(申請),都不能接在 approve 後面。

tip: 職責像畫好的一塊地,人站在那塊地裡面,事情就歸他管
example: Ms. Alvarez is in charge of the Taipei distribution center.
exampleZh: 阿爾瓦雷斯女士負責台北的物流中心。

quiz.q: While the director is away, Kevin will be ___ charge of the design team.
quiz.explanation: in charge of=負責,主任不在時由 Kevin 帶設計團隊。on 出現在 on duty(值班);at 出現在 at once(立刻);by 出現在 by means of(藉由),都無法構成「負責」的說法。

tip: advance 是往前走,把動作提前到事情發生之前
example: Please book the conference room at least two days in advance.
exampleZh: 請至少提前兩天預約會議室。

quiz.q: Payment for the catering service must be made three days ___ advance.
quiz.explanation: in advance=事先,外燴費用必須提前三天付清。on 出現在 on schedule(按進度);by 表示「不遲於某個時間點」(by Friday),後面要接時間點而非 advance;for 用在 for now(暫時),也沒有 for advance 的說法。

zh: 代表;代替(某人或某單位)
tip: 站在對方的位置上發言,替他出面
example: I am writing on behalf of our purchasing department in Taipei.
exampleZh: 我謹代表台北採購部門來函。

quiz.q: The vice president accepted the award ___ behalf of the whole research team.
quiz.explanation: on behalf of=代表某人或某單位,副總代表整個研究團隊領獎。at 出現在 at least(至少);for 是 apply for(申請);with 是 deal with(處理),都無法構成「代表」的說法。

tip: 貨已經走出倉庫了,架上空空如也
example: The blue model is out of stock until the end of the month.
exampleZh: 藍色款到月底前都缺貨。

quiz.q: We are sorry, but that printer cartridge is currently ___ of stock.
quiz.explanation: out of stock=缺貨,那款碳粉匣目前沒有庫存。off 出現在 day off(休假);away 出現在 put away(收好);over 出現在 take over(接手),都無法表示「沒有存貨」。

tip: 進度表像一條軌道,事情走在線上就沒誤點
example: Despite the storm, the construction project is still on schedule.
exampleZh: 儘管有暴風雨,這項工程仍照進度進行。

quiz.q: The renovation finished ___ schedule, so the store reopened last Monday.
quiz.explanation: on schedule=按預定進度,整修如期完成,商店上週一重新開幕。at 出現在 at present(目前);in 出現在 in advance(事先);to 是 respond to(回應)的搭配,都不能接 schedule 表示「準時」。

tip: 貨還在倉庫裡面,伸手就拿得到
example: We have all three sizes in stock at the main warehouse.
exampleZh: 三種尺寸我們主倉庫都有現貨。

quiz.q: Please check whether the replacement filters are still ___ stock.
quiz.explanation: in stock=有庫存,請確認替換濾芯是否還有現貨。on 出現在 on duty(值班);at 出現在 at work(在上班);by 出現在 by means of(藉由),都無法表示「有存貨」。

tip: 班表上輪到你的那一格,人正站在職務上
example: Two security guards are on duty at the main entrance tonight.
exampleZh: 今晚大門有兩名警衛值班。

quiz.q: The nurse who was ___ duty last night recorded every patient's temperature.
quiz.explanation: on duty=值班中,昨晚值班的護理師記錄了每位病人的體溫。in 出現在 in charge of(負責);at 出現在 at work(在工作中);for 是 register for(報名)的搭配,都無法表示「值勤」。

tip: by 帶出工具或手段,means 本身就是「方法」
example: Orders are confirmed by means of an automatic email reply.
exampleZh: 訂單是透過自動回覆郵件來確認的。

quiz.q: The samples were sent to the lab ___ means of a courier service.
quiz.explanation: by means of=藉由某種方法,樣本是透過快遞送到實驗室的。with 表示「用某件工具」(with a knife),不能接 means of;in 出現在 in terms of(就…而言);through 雖然也有「透過」的意思,但英文沒有 through means of 這種說法。

tip: terms 是先選好的一把尺,in 表示只在這把尺的範圍內比較
example: In terms of cost, the local supplier is clearly the better choice.
exampleZh: 就成本而言,本地供應商顯然是比較好的選擇。

quiz.q: The two models are similar ___ terms of speed but differ in price.
quiz.explanation: in terms of=就…而言,兩款機型速度相近但價格不同。on 出現在 on behalf of(代表);by 出現在 by means of(藉由);at 出現在 at least(至少),都不能接 terms of。

tip: 先講結果,再用 of 把手指回造成它的那件事
example: As a result of the merger, two branches will be closed.
exampleZh: 由於這次合併,將有兩家分公司關閉。

quiz.q: The delivery was delayed as a result ___ heavy snow in the north.
quiz.explanation: as a result of=由於,配送因為北部大雪而延誤。from 出現在 result from(起因於),那是動詞句型不能塞進 as a result ___;by 出現在 by means of(藉由);for 是 account for(說明)的搭配,都不能填入這個固定用法。
